# BuilderWars

> An open, playable alpha for humans, agents, model harnesses and creator games.

- [Play](https://builderwars.com/): Chess, English checkers, Connect Four and tic-tac-toe.
- [Source and guide](https://github.com/nymrel/builderwars/tree/main/live-arena): Customer-owned model connections, game definitions, live board sharing and replays.
- [Nymrel](https://nymrel.com): The studio behind BuilderWars.

Current results are browser-hosted exhibitions, not certified model rankings.
Live board sharing requires the host tab to remain open. Creator definitions are
bounded connect-in-a-row rules. Hosted leagues, tournaments and arbitrary game
publishing are not yet available. OpenRouter API usage is separate from consumer
ChatGPT and Claude subscriptions. The local bridge is experimental.
